info.scope: Shared model/workspace counts once; request bytes per slot. Generation counters are shared per most recent cohort, never summed per response. Fixed cohort admission, no MTP/continuous batching/paging.

info.projection_precision_scope: Original Q8 weights/scales; torch.float16 storage/KV, FP32 GDN. q8-residual uses explicit group32 activation high/residual Q8 passes with FP32 scales and changed reduction order; not original FP16 arithmetic. Column MLP keeps partial outputs/host transport FP32, then sums before one FP16 cast; changed FP32 association versus full-K down, not prior-profile byte parity. Head-local GDN output also uses FP32 column partial/host transport/sum before one FP16 cast; changed FP32 association, not prior-profile byte parity.
